ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `WaitAB` and both of its regions: `WaitA` and `WaitB` are active.
`A` is present: `HandleA` reaches its final state, `DoneA`. `HandleB` is still waiting, so `WaitAB` has not terminated.
Nothing happens. `HandleA` stays in its final state; it does not need `A` any more.
`B` is present: `HandleB` reaches `DoneB`. Now both regions are in final states, so `WaitAB` terminates and its `join to Done` fires in this tick: `O` is present.
`O` was a one-tick event. The chart rests in `Done`.
`Done` has no transitions, so new `A`s and `B`s change nothing. To start again, ABRO needs its R.
